title: Rotating solid disk, centrifugal body force (plane stress, quarter model)
description:
Solid steel disk of uniform thickness spinning about its axis at constant angular velocity, plane stress (thin disk). By symmetry only the quarter x >= 0, y >= 0 is modelled (STEP: planar quarter disk in the xy-plane, axis of rotation = z axis through the origin).
Geometry: quarter disk of radius b = 0.25 m centred at the origin. Edges: y = 0 from (0, 0) to (b, 0), the rim arc r = b, x = 0 from (0, b) to (0, 0). Thickness 0.02 m.
Material: linear elastic, E = 2e+11 Pa, nu = 0.3, density rho = 7850 kg/m^3.
Loads: rotation at omega = 1000 rad/s, i.e. the centrifugal body force (N/m^3) f = rho omega^2 (x, y) = (7850000000.0*x, 7850000000.0*y). No other loads; the rim is free.
Supports: symmetry on x = 0 (u_x = 0) and y = 0 (u_y = 0).
Report (SI units):
  ur_rim         radial displacement at the rim, u_x at (b, 0) [m]
  s_center       sigma_xx at the centre (0, 0) [Pa]
  hoop_rim       hoop stress at the rim, sigma_yy at (b, 0) [Pa]
  vm_max         maximum von Mises stress [Pa]
  strain_energy  total strain energy of the modelled quarter (given thickness) [J]
